result.title: Announced Breaks Separate Conformal Reliability from Frequency Calibration
result.comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). 53 pages, 7 figures
result.summary: An announced boundary reveals the partition before the first affected outcome, and a reset there serves one of two audits. The per-time audit reads conformal reliability, the expected distance of the threshold's coverage from nominal at miscoverage 0.1. The frequency audit reads frequency calibration, whether a closed window's error rate matched it. The reset rule, the post-boundary empirical quantile, attains the minimax per-time rate for independent scores. On bounded scores a recursion reset at the boundary attains a frequency gap of order one over the count when its floor adds a bounded total. At the 50th forecast after a large synthetic break, the reset rule's per-time gap stands below that of five adaptive methods, four from their authors' code, with every paired band below zero. After an electricity market reform, on 68 unseen scores, the band stands below zero against two, includes zero against two, adaptive conformal inference among them, and is a point at zero against one. After monetary policy decisions its pointwise band stands above zero against all five on 10 of the first 34 days. Of 9 announced boundaries one clears the smallest coverage difference its window detects, where every method's per-time gap at the 50th forecast exceeds the nominal miscoverage. Over the first 50 forecasts the reset recursion leads the frequency audit after every synthetic break.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究在「预先宣布的分布断点」前后如何审计阈值预测的可靠性：区分 per-time 的 conformal reliability 与窗口频率校准两种指标，提出在断点处重新设定阈值（reset recursion）的规则，并在合成断点与电力市场改革、货币政策等真实序列上，与五个自适应方法比较其覆盖率差距。
AI.relevance_reason: 其断点后自适应阈值的可靠性审计与重置递归，可能为 LVR 中随推理进程漂移的停止阈值或证据获取策略提供一种评价视角，可供核查该类审计指标能否用于 latent 推理轨迹的校准评估。
